Former German Spy Chief Arrested for Suspected Treasonous Espionage

Gerhard Schindler, former head of Germany's foreign intelligence agency, has been arrested on suspicion of treasonous espionage. He is accused of passing secret documents and allegedly provided money for them. The arrest was made by German authorities.
